scope: Round 3: previously observed weak 50-customer and long-budget 100-customer cases for development. Held-out includes new source mother 100-10-2 (nested 50/100) and unseen scenario02 of the observed 100-5-3 mother. Equal 5-second budgets and additional 15-second 100-customer B3 runs; 100000 iteration cap. Descriptive engineering comparison, no statistical significance or optimality claim.
selection_rule: Use only the 12 registered development jobs comprising 50-customer B2 at 5s and 100-customer B3 at 15s for pilots. Retain all candidates, choose one complete algorithm version using audited feasibility, paired mean distance, worst-seed distance and CV; freeze it before examining held-out quality. Final comparison uses every registered job, without per-job best-of selection.
